change_summary: Add efficiency guidelines instructing the agent to ask for the order ID up front, avoid enumerating all orders, stop once a match is found, and reuse already-fetched order data.
reason_for_change: get_order_details is the most-used tool (40 calls), with tasks 103 (12 calls) and 54 (15 calls) enumerating entire order histories. Prompting the agent to request the order ID first and stop enumerating after a match cuts redundant expensive lookups, lowering tool calls/turns and mean cost while preserving success since necessary lookups are still allowed.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.570334 >= threshold 0.549781 (best mean 0.580574 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The agent fetches every order individually (get_order_details called 40 times; tasks 23/54/103 fire 4-6 sequential get_order_details) to find the right order; a system-prompt instruction to ask the user for the order ID first, or to batch/minimize order lookups, reduces tool calls and turns.
